# template-literal-js-escaping skill

Qwen skill for safe template literal escaping in JavaScript.

## Purpose

- Avoid injection and quoting bugs in generated JS/TS strings.

## Ownership

- Local-router client team.

## Local Contracts

- Escape user-provided content before embedding in HTML/JS templates.

## Work Guidance

- Reuse this skill when modifying `src/ui/pages/*` or client scripts.

## Verification

- Run UI tests and inspect rendered output for escaped content.

## Child DOX Index

No child DOX files are required.
